title: uv installs from a pinned official release
goal: _tools/install-python.ps1 also installs uv from Astral's official Windows release archive, pinned by version and SHA-256 in the script, per user and after the same preflight (another uv on PATH or a uv the install would replace is a CONFLICT); pip is no longer the way the docs install uv on Windows.
notes: Today uv reaches a Windows clone through python -m pip install uv, unpinned: pip trusts PyPI over TLS but checks no hash the repository holds.
